Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
A minion fetches an Inscription and uses it to put a Rutor's Hand on another
minion. WHat happens exactly ?

- The actiong minion pays the blood ?
- Does the minion with the Rutor's go to torpor ?
- Does he get an extra action on his next turn ?

Etc.

Thanks,

Orpheus

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 26 Jan 2004 02:35:45 +0100, "Orpheus"
<orph...@DEADSPAMfree.fr> wrote:

>A minion fetches an Inscription and uses it to put a Rutor's Hand on another
>minion. WHat happens exactly ?

A thaumaturgical ritual takes place, 6 hours and 7 sacrificial virgins
later, a non-thaumaturge becomes capable of acting twice as often as
his counterparts.

>- The actiong minion pays the blood ?

The acting vampire pays the 1 blood cost of the card.
The minion that received the Inscription holding the Rutor's Hand will
pay the blood to not be in torpor if it eventually takes the Rutor's
Hand action.

>- Does the minion with the Rutor's go to torpor ?

Not unless the inscription was done with basic thaumaturgy, or the
minion takes the action at basic when it takes the action.

>- Does he get an extra action on his next turn ?

The turn after the receiver takes the Rutor's Hand action it will be
able to untap during its controller's minion phase.

In summary:
1) Action - Inscription holding Rutor's Hand
2) Rutor's Hand action
3) untaps begin

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
> And does the Rutor's stay on him, or burn after that ??

When the minion burns the Inscription to use Rutor's Hand, Rutor's
Hand's card text is applied:

[tha] Put this card on the acting vampire. The vampire takes 1 aggravated
damage (damage not preventable). Beginning with your next turn, the vampire
gets one additional untap during each of your minion phases for the
remainder of the game. A vampire can have only 1 Rutor's Hand.
[THA] As above, but the aggravated damage may be prevented by burning 3
additional blood.
